title: volver a = again, the past mood tense (hablara, comiera), quería que, esperaba que

cards.title: no quiero que se me cierre

examples.en: I don't want the door to close on me again.
examples.es: No quiero que la puerta se me cierre otra vez.

cards.title: volver a + verb = do again
cards.body: 'It returns to close' = it closes again. Volver is movement, so it takes a. Happen = pasar (also ocurrir, suceder).

examples.en: I don't want the door to close again.
examples.es: No quiero que la puerta vuelva a cerrarse.

examples.en: I don't want it to happen again.
examples.es: No quiero que vuelva a pasar.

cards.title: The past mood tense: from the 'they' dot past
cards.body: There's no future mood tense today. One past mood tense covers both the line and the dot. Take the 'they' dot form, change the last o to a, then work backwards.

cards.title: quería que / esperaba que + past mood
cards.body: English 'I was hoping he would call me' = Spanish 'I was hoping that he called me'.

examples.en: I wanted them to eat with us.
I was hoping he'd call me.

cards.title: With or without que
cards.body: No que, no mood tense. Que often signals that the mood tense may follow.

examples.en: We needed to talk to him.
We needed him to talk to us.

cards.title: volví a llamarte; para que + past mood
cards.body: A 'to' form (para organizar) avoids the mood tense; para que needs it.

examples.en: I called you again to organise.
I called you again so that we'd organise.
examples.es: Volví a llamarte para que organizáramos.
